verdict.rationale: Stripe's own offline docs say Terminal can store payments locally on the POS device or smart reader during connectivity issues. They also say the SDK or smart reader automatically forwards stored payments to Stripe when the network returns, which covers both parts of the story. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of offline operation, documentation of offline limits (e.g., amount caps, storage duration, failed-forwarding handling) and of which reader types are supported.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can keep taking card payments when the internet drops, with transactions stored and forwarded when connectivity returns

citations.quote: If you have internet connectivity issues, Stripe Terminal allows you to store payments locally on your POS device or smart reader. When a network connection is restored, the SDK or smart reader automatically forwards any stored payments to Stripe.
